name: n8n
free_plan_limits: Free trial on the cloud version; free Community Edition if you host it yourself
usage_note: Priced by workflow executions: 2,500 a month on Starter, 10,000 on Pro
best_for: Tinkerers who want to host it themselves
notes: Page shows euro prices on annual billing only (EUR 20 Starter, EUR 50 Pro); entered here as 20 without conversion. Self-host is under n8n's fair-code license, not a standard open-source one. Business plan is EUR 667.

name: Make
free_plan_limits: 1,000 credits a month, 1 MB data storage
usage_note: Each module action uses 1 credit; AI features can use more
since_note: Integromat went live in 2016 (Wikipedia mirror, citing Czech Wikipedia); some databases list 2012 as a start year; renamed Make in 2022.
best_for: Visual builders who want low per-run cost
notes: Make's pricing page text did not show plan prices to us. Search results from make.com say Core is $9 a month on annual billing for 10,000 credits; one Make blog post says $12. Monthly price not confirmed.

name: Zapier
free_plan_limits: 100 tasks a month, two-step Zaps only, 15-minute polling
usage_note: Priced by tasks; Pro starts at 750 tasks a month
since_note: Company founded 2011; platform launched 2012 through Y Combinator (Wikipedia).
notes: Pro is $19.99 a month if billed yearly. Team starts at $103.50 monthly. Premium apps and longer code runtime are paid only. Zapier Agents have a separate allowance (400 activities free).

name: Power Automate
free_plan_limits: 30-day free trial only on the pricing page
since_note: Launched as Microsoft Flow, generally available November 2016; renamed Power Automate in 2019 (Wikipedia).
notes: $15 per user a month, paid yearly. Unattended desktop bots cost $150 per bot a month. Basic flows come with some Microsoft 365 plans (not priced here). Copilot Studio agents are billed separately by credits.

name: Gumloop
free_plan_limits: About 2,000 credits a month, 1 seat, 1 active trigger
since_note: Started April 2023 as AgentHub, renamed Gumloop in 2024 (BetaKit).
notes: Pricing page did not load as text; figures come from Gumloop's own blog posts and search snippets. Team plan is $244 a month for 10 seats and 60,000+ credits.

name: Trigger.dev
free_plan_limits: $5 of compute a month, 20 concurrent runs, 1 day of logs
usage_note: $0.25 per 10,000 runs plus compute billed per second
since_note: Founded 2022, Y Combinator Winter 2023 batch (Y Combinator company page).
best_for: Developers running background jobs in code
notes: A code library for developers, not a drag-and-drop tool. Apache 2.0 license with a self-hosting guide. Hobby includes $10 of compute; Pro is $50 a month.

name: Relevance AI
free_plan_limits: Free plan retired for new and existing accounts
usage_note: Pro includes 2,500 actions a month plus vendor credits for AI models
since_note: Company founded 2020 in Sydney (Business News Australia).
best_for: Building AI agent teams for sales work
notes: Pro is $19 a month on annual billing, $29 monthly. Team is $234 annual or $349 monthly. Docs conflict on vendor-credit amounts. The main pricing page only showed Enterprise (2,000+ integrations).

name: IFTTT
free_plan_limits: 1,000 credits a month, unlimited applets, hourly checks
usage_note: Credits cover applet runs, AI steps and MCP use
since_note: Company founded 2010; product officially launched 7 September 2011 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Simple one-step home and app triggers
notes: Prices shown are the monthly equivalent of yearly plans ($25.08 and $65.88 a year); a pure monthly price was not stated. Pro+ is $13.99 for 100,000 credits.

name: Bardeen
usage_note: 1 credit per scraped row; 3 credits per enriched row
since_note: Company founded 2020; product launched out of stealth February 2022 (Business Wire).
best_for: Scraping web data into sheets and CRMs
notes: Basic is $10 a month for 100 credits; Premium $50 for 1,000 credits ($480 a year for 12,000). Unused credits expire each billing period. Page text was unclear; check before quoting.

name: Pipedream
free_plan_limits: Development only: no production environment, no real external users
best_for: Developers who want code plus ready apps
notes: Startup is $99 a month if billed yearly, $150 monthly. Page does not say the core product is open source; only an SDK and tool registry are on GitHub. Free plan cannot serve real users.

name: Activepieces
free_plan_limits: 1,000 credits a month, up to 5 users, unlimited flows
usage_note: Plus includes 10,000 credits; extra credits $0.007 each
since_note: Founded 2022, Y Combinator S22 batch (Y Combinator company page).
best_for: Open-source Zapier swap you can host
notes: Page says the core is open source but does not name the license. It cites 770+ integrations. Team plan is $200 a month for 50,000 credits.
